seo.title: Thank you: project request received
seo.description: Your project request has reached Calwebtech. Here is what happens next, when you will hear from us and when the proposal follows.

title: Thanks. Your project request is with us.
intro: Your details and your notes about the project have gone straight to the people who scope and price our work. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: Your name, work email and company
Your current website and the services you are interested in
Your budget range, when you want to start and your notes about the project

response.label: Expect a reply
response.detail: A person emails you to book a thirty minute call. The written proposal follows within two business days of that call.

steps.title: We review your request
steps.body: We look at your current site and what you told us, so the first conversation starts from your situation rather than a script.

steps.title: A thirty minute call
steps.body: At a time that suits you. Send your NDA beforehand if you need one and we will sign it before we talk.

steps.title: You get a written proposal
steps.body: Scope, timeline, a fixed price and exclusions, in writing, with no obligation. If we are not the right fit, we say so.

secondary.heading: While you wait
secondary.body: See how a project runs week by week, including what we will need from your team and when.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
